sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Combine those building blocks — not just single words in isolation, but plurals and possessives inside real sentences.

Ez a könyvem stacks the demonstrative ez ('this') with the possessive -m ('my') on könyv; a barátok itt vannak stacks the plural -k on barát with the plural van vannak. Once each piece is familiar on its own, this is what using them together actually sounds like.
